title: GrantThai NRIIS render-only field record (one line of registry/nriis-fields.jsonl)
description: Draft. Namespace NRIIS.<TAB>.<FIELD> is render-only: records are GENERATED by tools/registry/build_nriis_fields.py from registry/fields.jsonl (origin NRIIS_NATIVE only) and mappings/nriis/section_to_tab.yaml, and nobody authors NRIIS.* fields directly (P2). Tab names, tab order (entry_order) and labels describe ONE observed form and stay NEEDS_VERIFICATION until confirmed from a public call or TOR document (founder ruling K14).

entry_order.description: Position within the tab on the observed form (NEEDS_VERIFICATION).

label_th.description: Literal NEEDS_VERIFICATION until captured from a public call/TOR document (K14).

core_field_id.description: The authoring field (registry/fields.jsonl) this NRIIS field is rendered from.

origin.description: Only NRIIS_NATIVE registry records are rendered onto an NRIIS tab (core/02 R4).

render_from.description: For a narrative field: the registry fields the text is written from (copied from registry/fields.jsonl).
